Project Objectives and Team The objective of this project is to develop an innovative sorbent structure of trapped small amines in HNC embedded in PEF for DAC. This involves tailoring both sorbent and PEF materials to achieve a compact system for DAC with high capacity for CO at concentrations typically 2 available in air and at near ambient conditions. The Project Team is comprised of The State University of New York at Buffalo (UB) and GTI Energy (GTI). The program utilizes each Team Member’s unique expertise (UB: sorbent development and PEF development; GTI: process design and analysis) that is critical to advance the proposed technology from the current TRL 2 to TRL 3. 9 2.
